QA Tester Summary — Issue #140: [Authentication] 2. Register Manual

Verdict: PASS — no coding defect found in the manual registration flow and sign-up dialog.

Suite: qa_testing/tests/e2e/authentication/issue_140_register_manual_real_site.spec.ts (rerunnable automated suite)

Real-site environment: Production https://villume.com · Tester account jsy9 · 09 Sep 2026

Test Summary

# Method Scenario Expected result Confusion Matrix Result
1 White Box Inspect Sign-Up modal DOM, form controls, required validators, and password toggle Dialog opens with #su-first, #su-last, #su-email, #su-pw, and submit button in disabled state until all required fields and reCAPTCHA are valid. Client validation correctly enforces required first/last name, valid email format, and min 6 characters password. Password toggle cleanly flips between password and text. TP PASS
2 Gray Box Inspect Google reCAPTCHA container integration and reactive form binding reCAPTCHA explicit container (#captchaSignUp) mounts cleanly. Form controls bind reactively to Angular FormGroup, preventing submission with invalid data or unverified captcha token. TP PASS
3 Black Box End-to-end guest navigation flow, Log In / Sign Up switching, and modal dismissal Seamless switching between Sign Up and Log In dialogs without component state leakage; modal header close button and backdrop dismissal work as expected. TP PASS
4 Black Box Form validation guards for empty fields and malformed email inputs Leaving required fields blank triggers corresponding error messages ("First name is required", "Email is required"); malformed email triggers "Email is not valid". Submit button remains strictly disabled. TN PASS
5 Regression Guard Dialog responsiveness and state cleanup Registration dialog conforms to PrimeNG responsive constraints (width: 427px, maxWidth: calc(100vw - 24px)) without horizontal scroll issues. TN PASS

Code Review

Area Evidence Result
Dialog structure & styling SignUpComponent is properly rendered inside PrimeNG p-dialog.show-login shell with closeIcon="vi vi-x" and clean z-index layering. PASS
Form validation & reactive control FormGroup enforces strict validation ([Validators.required, Validators.pattern('[a-zA-Z0-9 ]*')] for names, [Validators.required, Validators.email] for email, [Validators.required, Validators.minLength(6)] for password, and Validators.requiredTrue for terms agreement). PASS
Password toggle safety Toggle button (.input-toggle) toggles type attribute between password and text safely without altering typed credentials. PASS
Google reCAPTCHA integration Dynamically loads Google reCAPTCHA explicit script and binds verification callbacks with resetGrecaptcha() cleanup on destroy/error. PASS
Post-registration routing Upon successful registration, app sets session state and redirects to /welcome flow with registration state payload. PASS

QA Tester Summary — Issue #143: [Authentication] 5. Forgot Password

Verdict: PASS — no coding defect found in the password recovery and forgot-password dialog flow.

Suite: qa_testing/tests/e2e/authentication/issue_143_forgot_password_real_site.spec.ts (rerunnable automated suite)

Real-site environment: Production https://villume.com · Tester account jsy9 · 09 Sep 2026

Test Summary

# Method Scenario Expected result Confusion Matrix Result
1 White Box Inspect Forgot Password modal DOM, reactive form controls, email validator, and back-to-login navigation Dialog opens with header Reset your password, email input #forgot-email, and submit button in disabled state until valid email is provided and reCAPTCHA is solved. Client validation correctly requires email and enforces valid format. Back to login cleanly closes forgot password dialog and restores Login dialog. TP PASS
2 Gray Box Inspect reCAPTCHA container integration, explicit rendering lifecycle, and reactive form state binding Google reCAPTCHA explicit container ([id^="captchaForgotModal-"]) mounts cleanly within the modal. Form input value binds reactively to FormGroup, preventing submission without valid captcha token. TP PASS
3 Black Box End-to-end guest navigation flow, dialog dismiss via close icon, and re-opening lifecycle Full guest navigation cycle (Header Log in → Login Dialog → Forgot Password → Close Dialog → Header Log in → Forgot Password) transitions cleanly without UI freezing, backdrop leaks, or stale state. TP PASS
4 Black Box Form validation guards for empty and malformed email inputs Focusing and leaving email blank displays "Email is required"; entering malformed strings displays "Enter a valid email address". Submit button remains strictly disabled. TN PASS
5 Regression Guard Dialog responsiveness and state isolation Forgot Password modal conforms to PrimeNG responsive breakpoint constraints (width: 427px, maxWidth: calc(100vw - 24px)) without horizontal viewport overflow. TN PASS

Code Review

Area Evidence Result
Dialog structure & accessibility ForgotPasswordModalComponent is properly rendered inside PrimeNG p-dialog.show-login shell with closeIcon="vi vi-x" and clean z-index layering (baseZIndex="10000"). PASS
Form validation & reactive control FormGroup enforces [Validators.required, Validators.email]. Submit button (button[type="submit"]) is disabled while form is invalid, loading, or captcha is unverified. PASS
Google reCAPTCHA explicit integration Dynamically loads reCAPTCHA script (api.js?render=explicit) and binds callbacks for token capture and expiration, clearing state gracefully on destroy. PASS
Navigation & state management backToLogin() updates layoutsService.displayForgotPasswordDialog = false and mainService.displayLoginDialog = true, preserving navigation state without stale forms. PASS
Confirmation & retry flow Sent view (.auth-card--sent) correctly displays target email confirmation, Back to log in button, and Try again action which increments captchaKey and resets captcha cleanly. PASS
